name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a junior silver-gold explorer with its flagship Diablillos project located in Salta Province, Argentina. The company is in the development stage with a completed pre-feasibility study reporting proven and probable reserves of 42.3 Mt grading 91 g/t Ag and 0.81 g/t Au. In 2026, AbraSilver completed the acquisition of the Condoryacu and Maria Amalia properties, expanding its land package directly adjacent to Diablillos, with an active Phase VI drill program underway.
